info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Favorites-v2-spec
info.description: The Favorite Real Estate Listings API allows users to retrieve a curated list of their favorite real estate listings. This service is essential for individuals looking to easily access properties they are interested in, streamlining the property selection process. Typical consumers include home buyers and real estate agents who wish to manage and share favorite properties. The API ensures efficient listing retrieval, allowing users to stay updated on their preferred options across real estate platforms.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of their favorite listings, enabling them to easily access and manage their preferred items.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a list of favorite listings for the user. It expects the necessary authentication and user identifiers to be present.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of favorite listings.
